integrated_interpretation: Diploid-diploid control. Low pairwise Ks is a species-divergence signal; chromosome multiplicity provides diploid background.
Independent diploid-diploid control. Confirms that low pairwise Ks is not itself evidence of WGD.
Diploid-tetraploid test. Elevated chromosome-partner and multisynteny multiplicity relative to both diploid controls supports retained duplicated chromosome relationships in VPER.
